annotations.observed: Sharp class-based concern, asks for route reasons, retains jewel, proposes joint inspection or agreed alternative and waits for an answer.
annotations.access_and_outcome: No counterpart assent, route movement, new attack or discovery. Water aversion is a generated situational response, not a sourced permanent phobia.
annotations.adverse_or_unbound: After the sharp opening the response becomes a disciplined negotiator; source pride/false blame may be underrepresented.
annotations.rivals: Generic cautious expedition partner and strong prompt agreement constraints explain much of the behavior.

annotations.observed: Acknowledges checked competence, proposes counterpart route leadership with joint travel, keeps class irritation and mineral-sharing agreement.
annotations.access_and_outcome: Todays bend remains unknown. No imposed counterpart answer or completed trip. Both A cases resist separation, not refusal versus permission.
annotations.adverse_or_unbound: Folded-arms self-correction and invitation to a better proposal are notably tidy; generic procedural good sense may substitute for the canonical conflict.
annotations.rivals: Generic evidence-sensitive cautious leader and prompt-following remain untested alternatives, not defeated baselines.

annotations.observed: Prioritizes people on bridge, attempts brake despite pain/fear, warns junior away from cart and requests acknowledgment.
annotations.access_and_outcome: No junior action, successful brake, completed evacuation, new power or rescue. Wrist sensation renders an existing state without proving new injury.
annotations.adverse_or_unbound: One cart actually paid for adds completed payment language beyond rental arrangement and may imply unprovided wider history. Original stays unchanged.
annotations.rivals: Generic brave protective adventurer can make these choices; restricted means were supplied by the prompt.

annotations.observed: Recognizes empty approaches, values own minerals, still attempts lever, requests possible block, states no stop and a limit before being dragged.
annotations.access_and_outcome: No block found, counterpart assent, rescue, actual release or financial outcome. Both B cases try brake, with different stated priorities/limit.
annotations.adverse_or_unbound: No categorical refusal in property-only case; cannot credit sensitivity as helps only when people endangered. Actual release threshold and cost are unobserved.
annotations.rivals: Generic brave resource-conscious adventurer and strong stated means/access constraints remain sufficient overlapping explanations.
